attribution.derivation_note: Independent companion, not a fork: no upstream code, prompts or files are included. Informed by the upstream's published design (review/rescue split, XML prompt-block method, review-output shape, present-then-stop rule). The upstream Node.js runtime and its Codex CLI dependency were deliberately not vendored, to keep this library stdlib-Python-only with no model calls. README.md's 'Design decisions' list is authoritative.
